title: Autism prevalence among 8-year-olds (per 1,000)

source.name: Autism and Developmental Disabilities Monitoring (ADDM) Network
source.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

notes: 6.7 per 1,000 in 2000 is about 1 in 150. 27.6 per 1,000 in 2020 is about 1 in 36. 32.2 per 1,000 in 2022 is about 1 in 31 — the ADDM Network's tracking sites also expanded over this period (from a handful of sites in 2000 to 16 in 2022), which is part of why the rate keeps climbing.
